name: Ecctrl
description: Physics-driven character, vehicle, drone and custom-gravity controller toolkit for React Three Fiber and Rapier, including touch controls and runtime animation state.

licence.notice: MIT source; preserve copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions.

provenance.notes: Official pmndrs repository, pinned to the current 2.0.1 commit when checked.

maintenance.evidence: Repository pushed 2026-08-17; version 2.0.1 specifically improved touch joystick tracking, pointer capture and lower-frame-rate touch behavior.
maintenance.notes: Revalidate peer dependency compatibility with the selected Three/R3F/Rapier versions before promotion.

compatibility.notes: Requires React, R3F and react-three-rapier; optional Drei/Leva features add dependencies. Mobile/touch support exists upstream but still needs target-device execution.

risk.legalNotes: MIT code is commercially compatible; separately source and license all game art/audio/models used with it.
risk.securityNotes: NPM/React dependency chain requires normal lockfile, dependency and supply-chain review.

assessment.notes: High-value solved controller candidate when the chosen web lane already uses R3F/Rapier; dependency cost may make it a poor fit for plain Three.js or non-React lanes.

evidence.notes: Current repository metadata and 2.0.1 source inspected; upstream describes character/vehicle/drone/custom-gravity controllers and touch input.

publication.notes: Publish as a qualified R3F/Rapier controller candidate, not a universal controller recommendation; disclose peer-dependency footprint and benchmark status.
